protocol_variants.title: Iodate clock mixture B
protocol_variants.sample_policy: Independent protocol; do not concatenate with other variants. Within this protocol preserve each named sample; new aliquots/trials need separate state tracks and reference images.

procedure_steps.instruction: Prepare stock A: 25 mL 6% potassium iodate, 25 mL 2 M sulphuric acid and 50 mL water in a 250 mL flask.
procedure_steps.observation: Stock A is separate from the reaction flask.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Prepare stock B: 20 mL 6% sodium sulphite, 5 mL 5% starch and 75 mL water in a separate 250 mL flask.
procedure_steps.observation: This stock totals 100 mL; only an aliquot enters the reaction.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Combine 25 mL A and 25 mL B in fresh flask F; stir, time from halfway through addition and record the blue endpoint. Repeat twice with fresh aliquots.
procedure_steps.observation: Blue endpoint time is measured for this mixture.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.
